## Description

A choanoflagellate (~6–9 µm), the closest unicellular relative of animals. A single flagellum
surrounded by a collar of ~40 microvilli; the flagellum beats and pushes water through the collar,
where bacteria are retained and then phagocytosed at its base. The swimming form advances with the
flagellum behind (a pusher), so collar and mouth are at the rear pole.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 8 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

[Posterior flagellum](../../mechanics/locomotion.md) (pusher) with `posterior_mouth`; the collar is a fan of covering
processes finer than the membrane. Speed estimated; no published µmax.
